response.sql: SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time FROM film AS f WHERE f.length >= 112 OR f.length IS NULL GROUP BY f.language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time IS NULL ASC, avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Films with missing running time are included because the request says to ignore missing values in each average; they do not contribute to the running-time average, but can contribute to average replacement cost.

alternatives.interpretation: If “at least 112 minutes” excludes films with missing running time, filter them out; the missing-value instruction then applies to replacement cost.
